description: A photograph of a man-made water reservoir, likely used for irrigation, taken in 2012. The reservoir features a concrete border around its perimeter and is enclosed by a wire mesh fence, topped with barbed wire, supported by concrete posts. The water surface reflects the sky, which appears to be at dusk or dawn. A single blue object is floating in the water. The surrounding landscape consists of rural or agricultural land. The image is attributed to "©European Union, 2012" and "LUCAS" (Land Use and Land Cover Area frame Survey).
